description: This file contains a test class for the I18NImportErrorAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It defines test cases for API endpoints related to internationalization import errors, including setup methods, test cases for fetching all records, and placeholders for create and delete operations.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorAPITest
classes.description: Test class for the I18NImportErrorAPI, extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase, covering retrieval, creation, and deletion of import error entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment by truncating specific tables and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API endpoint for fetching all import error records, using data providers.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for 'testGetAll' method from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that creating a new import error via API is not implemented and raises an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rule retrieval for create operation, expecting an exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete operation is not implemented and raises an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rule retrieval for delete operation, expecting an exception.
